description: Searches images with a FREE licence for a scene (Openverse and Wikimedia Commons; only CC0, public domain and CC BY: commercial use and edits allowed). Returns options with thumbnail, page, licence, the on-screen credit and a suggested file name (web-*.jpg). Show them to the user and wait for their choice: nothing goes in without it. Then studio_enviar_midia (url = arquivo_url, nome = nome_sugerido) and put "credito" on the scene’s conteudo (imagem/broll) or fala.real. English search words find more. Free; nothing is stored.

busca.description: What the image shows, a few words (e.g. 'pencil and eraser').

cena.description: Scene id it is for (optional, echoed back).

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

name: studio_sugerir_imagens
title: Studio: suggest free-licence images
